senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. f. Naamah, 1) sister of Tubal-Cain.

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 23:3">Gen. R. s. 23</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 4:22">Gen. IV, 22</cite>) <he>למה היו קורין אותה נ׳ וכ׳</he> why was she (the wife of Noah) called N.?
